Write the commit message in English following Conventional Commits as enforced by commitlint in this repository:

- Header: `<type>(<optional scope>): <description>.`
- Allowed types: fix, feat, doc, perf, refactor, style, test, chore. Use `!` before the colon for breaking changes.
- Suggested scopes: download, analysis, settings, storage, deps, ci, docs, devcontainer.
- The description is an imperative summary and MUST end with a period.
- Optional body after one blank line, free form, in English.
- Optional footers after one blank line (`Refs: #12`, `BREAKING CHANGE: ...`).
